items.title: Index Provider MSCI Removes Strategy From Equity Benchmark
items.summary: MSCI Inc. has dropped Strategy Inc. from its global equity benchmarks, potentially triggering billions of dollars in stock sales and adding fresh pressure to the financing model behind Michael Saylor’s vast Bitcoin holdings.

items.title: Strategy shares fall after MSCI confirms deletion from US large-cap benchmark
items.summary: Investing.com -- Shares of Strategy Inc (NASDAQ:MSTR) fell 2.4% in extended trading Wednesday after index provider MSCI Inc. confirmed it will drop the company from its benchmark equity indexes as part of its November 2026 review. The deletion removes Strategy’s Class A shares from the MSCI USA Large Cap Index, threatening to trigger billions of dollars in passive fund outflows.

items.title: MSCI Drops Strategy From Its US Index: Will $2.8 Billion in Forced Selling Hit MSTR?
items.summary: MSCI will cut MicroStrategy (now Strategy) from its USA Index on November 30, forcing passive funds to sell MSTR shares.

items.title: JPMorgan Says Strategy Could Face $2.8 Billion in Forced Selling. What Would That Do to the Bitcoin Price?
items.summary: Index funds may dump Strategy shares, yet the company's 850,364 bitcoin never changes hands in that trade. The real risk to Bitcoin hides in how Strategy pays for what comes next, and one set of filings will reveal it.
